route_summary: Boto3 Bedrock Knowledge Bases example with retrieve and retrieve-and-generate calls, bounded result selection, and unmodified response citations for caller display.
supported_boundary: Python 3.11+ boto3 1.43.114, provisioned Knowledge Base/data source/vector store, permitted model, and buyer account credentials. Calls can incur retrieval/inference charges. Hosted preview does not make a remote request.
